name: ner-landslide-cell-day
question: Does a model trained on past landslides and rainfall rank the places and days of rainfall-triggered landslides in North East India better than baseline-v1, a rainfall threshold rule and climatology, on years it never saw?

unit.day: UTC calendar day of the rainfall record; event dates are taken as reported

labels.observed_area: cells with at least one kept event in the training years

rainfall.title: NOAA Climate Data Record PERSIANN-CDR daily precipitation, v01r01
rainfall.licence: No constraints on data access or use (stated in every file's metadata)

terrain.title: SRTM 1 arc-second elevation, as Tilezen skadi tiles
terrain.licence: Public domain (U.S. Geological Survey); attribution as in the README

events.title: NASA Global Landslide Catalog export (2007 to 2017)
events.resolution: points with a stated location accuracy
events.licence: Listed as public access by NASA on data.gov, with no licence restriction stated; a U.S. Government Work where prepared by NASA staff. NASA asks users to cite Kirschbaum et al. (2010), Natural Hazards 52:561-575, and Kirschbaum et al. (2015), Geomorphology 249:4-15. The export's 'Terms and Conditions' text is not published with the record.

gate.rule: A candidate passes only if its test PR-AUC interval lies wholly above every benchmark's interval and its test Brier score is below climatology's.
